name: Livepeer
description: Livepeer is a decentralized video infrastructure that lets developers stream live or on-demand video and run AI-powered processing at lower cost than centralized platforms

methodology.Fees: Fees paid by broadcasters for using the Livepeer protocol.
methodology.Revenue: All the fees go to orchestrators and delegators who stake LPT tokens.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: All the fees go to orchestrators and delegators who stake LPT tokens.
